verses.en: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
verses.am: ትእዛዜን ብትሰማ ኖሮ፥ ሰላምህ እንደ ወንዝ ጽድቅህም እንደ ባሕር ሞገድ በሆነ ነበር፤

verses.en: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
verses.am: ዘርህም እንደ አሸዋ የሆድህም ትውልድ እንደ ምድር ትቢያ በሆነ ነበር፥ ስሙም ከፊቴ ባልጠፋና ባልፈረሰ ነበር።

verses.en: Go ye forth of Babel, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, YAHUAH hath redeemed his servant Ya'aqob.
verses.am: ከባቢሎን ውጡ ከከለዳውያንም ኰብልሉ፤ በእልልታ ድምፅ ተናገሩ ይህንም ንገሩ እስከ ምድርም ዳርቻ ድረስ አውሩና። እግዚአብሔር ባሪያውን ያዕቆብን ታድጎታል በሉ።

verses.en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ በኩል በመራቸው ጊዜ አልተጠሙም፤ ውኃንም ከዓለቱ ውስጥ አፈለቀላቸው፥ ዓለቱንም ሰነጠቀ ውኃውም ፈሰሰ።

verses.en: There is no peace, saith YAHUAH, unto the wicked.
verses.am: ለክፉዎች ሰላም የላቸውም ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; YAHUAH hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
verses.am: ደሴቶች ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፥ እናንተም በሩቅ ያላችሁ አሕዛብ፥ አድምጡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከማኅፀን ጠርቶኛል፥ ከእናቴም ሆድ ጀምሮ ስሜን አንሥቶአል፤

verses.en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
verses.am: አፌንም እንደ ተሳለ ሰይፍ አድርጎአል፥ በእጁ ጥላ ሰውሮኛል፤ እንደ ተሳለ ፍላጻም አድርጎኛል፥ በሰገባውም ውስጥ ሽጎኛል።

verses.en: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Yisra'el, in whom I will be glorified.
verses.am: እርሱም። እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ባሪያዬ ነህ በአንተም እከበራለሁ አለኝ።

verses.en: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with YAHUAH, and my work with my YAHUAH.
verses.am: እኔ ግን። በከንቱ ደከምሁ፥ ምንም ጥቅም ለሌለውና ለከንቱ ጕልበቴን ፈጀሁ፤ ፍርዴ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ፥ ዋጋዬም በአምላኬ ዘንድ ነው አልሁ።

verses.en: And now, saith YAHUAH that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Ya'aqob again to him, Though Yisra'el be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of YAHUAH, and my YAHUAH shall be my strength.
verses.am: አሁንም በእግዚአብሔር ዓይን ከብሬአለሁና፥ አምላኬም ጕልበት ሆኖኛልና ያዕቆብን ወደ እርሱ እንድመልስ እስራኤልንም ወደ እርሱ እንድሰበስብ ባሪያ እሆነው ዘንድ ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ የሠራኝ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Ya'aqob, and to restore the preserved of Yisra'el: I will also give thee for a light to the nations, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
verses.am: እርሱም። የያዕቆብን ነገዶች እንድታስነሣ ከእስራኤልም የዳኑትን እንድትመስል ባሪያዬ ትሆን ዘንድ እጅግ ቀላል ነገር ነውና እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ መድኃኒት ትሆን ዘንድ ለአሕዛብ ብርሃን አድርጌ ሰጥቼሃለሁ ይላል።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, the Redeemer of Yisra'el, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of YAHUAH that is faithful, and the Holy One of Yisra'el, and he shall choose thee.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ታዳጊ ቅዱሱም፥ እግዚአብሔር፥ ሰዎች ለሚንቁት ሕዝብም ለሚጠላው ለገዥዎች ባሪያ እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ ታማኙ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ስለ መረጠህም ስለ እስራኤል ቅዱስ ነገሥታት አይተው ይነሣሉ፥ መሳፍንትም አይተው ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በተወደደ ጊዜ ሰምቼሃለሁ፥ በመድኃኒትም ቀን ረድቼሃለሁ፤ እጠብቅህማለሁ፥ ምድርንም ታቀና ዘንድ፥ ውድማ የሆኑትንም ርስቶች ታወርስ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
verses.am: የተጋዙትንም። ውጡ በጨለማም የተቀመጡትን። ተገለጡ ትል ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳን አድርጌ ለሕዝቡ ሰጥቼሃለሁ። በመንገድም ላይ ይሰማራሉ፥ ማሰማርያቸውም በወና ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
verses.am: የሚራራላቸውም ይመራቸዋልና፥ በውኃም ምንጮች በኩል ይነዳቸዋልና አይራቡም፥ አይጠሙም፥ ትኩሳት ወይም ፀሐይ አይጐዳቸውም።

verses.en: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.am: ተራሮቼንም ሁሉ መንገድ አደርጋለሁ፥ ጎዳኖቼም ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ።

verses.en: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እነዚህ ከሩቅ፥ እነሆም፥ እነዚህ ከሰሜንንና ከምዕራብ፥ እነዚህም ከሲኒም አገር ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for YAHUAH hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አጽናንቶአልና፥ ለችግረኞቹም ራርቶአልና ሰማያት ሆይ፥ ዘምሩ፥ ምድር ሆይ፥ ደስ ይበልሽ ተራሮችም ሆይ፥ እልል በሉ።

verses.en: But Zion said, YAHUAH hath forsaken me, and my Master hath forgotten me.
verses.am: ጽዮን ግን። እግዚአብሔር ትቶኛል ጌታም ረስቶኛል አለች።

verses.en: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
verses.am: በውኑ ሴት ከማኅፀንዋ ለተወለደው ልጅ እስከማትራራ ድረስ ሕፃንዋን ትረሳ ዘንድ ትችላለችን? አዎን፥ እርስዋ ትረሳ ይሆናል፥ እኔ ግን አልረሳሽም።

verses.en: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ በእጄ መጻፍ ቀርጬሻለሁ፥ ቅጥሮችሽም ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ አሉ።

verses.en: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.
verses.am: ልጆችሽ ይፈጥናሉ፤ ያፈረሱሽና ያወደሙሽ ከአንቺ ዘንድ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith YAHUAH, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.
verses.am: ዓይንሽን አንሥተሽ በዙሪያሽ ተመልከቺ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ ተሰብስበው ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ። እኔ ሕያው ነኝና እነዚህን ሁሉ እንደ ጌጥ ትለብሻቸዋለሽ፥ እንደ ሙሽራም ትጐናጸፊአቸዋለሽ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
verses.am: ባድማሽና ውድማሽ ወናም የሆነው ምድርሽ ከሚኖሩብሽ የተሣ ዛሬ ጠባብ ትሆናለችና፥ የዋጡሽም ይርቃሉና።

verses.en: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
verses.am: የወላድ መካን ከሆንሽ በኋላ የተወለዱልሽ ልጆችሽ በጆሮሽ። ስፍራ ጠብቦኛልና እቀመጥ ዘንድ ቦታ አስፊልኝ ይላሉ።

verses.en: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
verses.am: አንቺም በልብሽ፥ የወላድ መካን ሆኛለሁና፥ እኔም ብቻዬን ተሰድጄአለሁና ተቅበዝበዤ አለሁምና እነዚህን ማን ወለደልኝ? እነዚህንስ ማን አሳደጋቸው? እነሆ፥ ብቻዬን ቀርቼ ነበር፤ እነዚህስ ወዴት ነበሩ? ትያለሽ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the nations, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ እጄን ወደ አሕዛብ አነሣለሁ፥ ዓለማዬንም ወደ ወገኖች አቆማለሁ፤ ወንዶች ልጆችሽንም በብብታቸው ያመጡአቸዋል፥ ሴቶች ልጆችሽንም በጫንቃቸው ላይ ይሸከሙአቸዋል።

verses.en: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am YAHUAH: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
verses.am: ነገሥታትም አሳዳጊ አባቶችሽ ይሆናሉ፥ እቴጌዎቻቸውም ሞግዚቶችሽ ይሆናሉ፤ ግምባራቸውንም ወደ ምድር ዝቅ አድርገው ይሰግዱልሻል፥ የእግርሽንም ትቢያ ይልሳሉ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂያለሽ፥ እኔንም በመተማመን የሚጠባበቁ አያፍሩም።

verses.en: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
verses.am: በውኑ ብዝበዛ ከኃያል እጅ ይወሰዳልን? ወይስ የጨካኙ ምርኮኞች ያመልጣሉን?

verses.en: But thus saith YAHUAH, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን እንዲህ ይላል። በኃያላን የተማረኩ ይወሰዳሉ፥ የጨካኞችም ብዝበዛ ያመልጣል፤ ከአንቺ ጋር የሚጣሉትን እጣላቸዋለሁ፥ ልጆችሽንም አድናለሁ።

verses.en: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I YAHUAH am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: አስጨናቂዎችሽንም ሥጋቸውን አስበላቸዋለሁ፥ እንደ ጣፋጭም ወይን ጠጅ ደማቸውን ጠጥተው ይሰክራሉ፤ ሥጋ ለባሹም ሁሉ እኔ እግዚአብሔር መድኃኒትሽና ታዳጊሽ፥ የያዕቆብ ኃያል እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃል።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እናታችሁን የፈታሁበት የፍችዋ ጽሕፈት የት አለ? ወይስ እናንተን የሸጥሁ ከአበዳሪዎች ለየትኛው ነው? እነሆ፥ ስለ ኃጢአታችሁ ተሽጣችኋል፥ ስለ በደላችሁም እናታችሁ ተፈትታለች።

verses.en: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
verses.am: በመጣሁስ ጊዜ ሰው ስለ ምን አልነበረም? በጠራሁስ ጊዜ የሚመልስ ስለ ምን አልነበረም? መታደግ እንዳትችል እጄ አጭር ሆናለችን? ወይስ ለማዳን ኃይል የለኝምን? እነሆ፥ በገሠጽሁ ጊዜ ባሕርን አደርቃለሁ፥ ወንዞችንም ምድረ በዳ አደርጋቸዋለሁ፤ ውኃም በማጣት ዓሦቻቸው ይገማሉ በጥማትም ይሞታሉ።

verses.en: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
verses.am: ሰማያትን ጥቍረት አለብሳቸዋለሁ፥ መጋረጃቸውንም ማቅ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
verses.am: የደከመውን በቃል እንዴት እንደምደግፍ አውቅ ዘንድ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር የተማሩትን ምላስ ሰጥቶኛል ማለዳ ማለዳ ያነቃኛል፥ እንደ ተማሪዎችም ትሰማ ዘንድ ጆሮዬን ያነቃቃል።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ጆሮዬን ከፍቶአል፥ እኔም ዓመፀኛ አልነበርሁም ወደ ኋላዬም አልተመለስሁም።

verses.en: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
verses.am: ጀርባዬን ለገራፊዎች ጕንጬንም ለጠጕር ነጪዎች ሰጠሁ፥ ፊቴንም ከውርደትና ከትፋት አልመለስሁም።

verses.en: For YAHUAH will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛልና ስለዚህ አልታወክሁም፤ ስለዚህም ፊቴን እንደ ባልጩት ድንጋይ አድርጌዋለሁ፥ እንዳላፍርም አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
verses.am: የሚያጸድቀኝ ቅርብ ነው፤ ከእኔስ ጋር የሚከራከር ማን ነው? በአንድነት እንቁም፤ የሚከራከረኝ ማን ነው? ወደ እኔ ይቅረብ።

verses.en: Behold, YAHUAH will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛል፤ ማን ይፈርድብኛል? እነሆ፥ ሁሉ እንደ ልብስ ያረጃሉ ብልም ይበላቸዋል።

verses.en: Who is among you that feareth YAHUAH, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of YAHUAH, and stay upon his YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከእናንተ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ፥ የባሪያውንም ቃል የሚሰማ፥ በጨለማም የሚሄድ፥ ብርሃንም የሌለው፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ስም የሚታመን፥ በአምላኩም የሚደገፍ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እሳት የምታነድዱ የእሳትንም ወላፈን የምትታጠቁ ሁላችሁ፥ በእሳታችሁ ነበልባል ባነደዳችሁትም ወላፈን ሂዱ፤ ይህ ከእጄ ይሆንባችኋል፤ በኀዘን ትተኛላችሁ።

verses.en: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek YAHUAH: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.
verses.am: እናንተ ጽድቅን የምትከተሉ እግዚአብሔርንም የምትሹ፥ ስሙኝ፤ ከእርሱ የተቈረጣችሁበትን ድንጋይ ከእርሱም የተቈፈራችሁበትን ጕድጓድ ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
verses.am: ወደ አባታችሁ ወደ አብርሃም፥ ወደ ወለደቻችሁም ወደ ሳራ ተመልከቱ፤ አንድ ብቻውን በሆነ ጊዜ ጠራሁት፥ ባረክሁትም አበዛሁትም።

verses.en: For YAHUAH shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of YAHUAH; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ጽዮንን ያጽናናል፤ በእርስዋም ባድማ የሆነውን ሁሉ ያጽናናል፥ ምድረ በዳዋንም እንደ ዔደን በረሀዋንም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ገነት ያደርጋል፤ ደስታና ተድላ ምስጋናና የዝማሬ ድምፅ ይገኝበታል።

verses.en: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
verses.am: ወገኔ ሆይ፥ አድምጠኝ፤ ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ስማኝ፤ ሕግ ከእኔ ይወጣልና ፍርዴም ለአሕዛብ ብርሃን ይሆናልና።

verses.en: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
verses.am: ጽድቄ ፈጥኖ ቀርቦአል፥ ማዳኔም ወጥቶአል፥ ክንዴም በአሕዛብ ላይ ይፈርዳል፤ ደሴቶች እኔን በመተማመን ይጠባበቃሉ፥ በክንዴም ይታመናሉ።

verses.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
verses.am: ዓይናችሁን ወደ ሰማይ አንሡ፥ ወደ ታችም ወደ ምድር ተመልከቱ፤ ሰማያት እንደ ጢስ በንነው ይጠፋሉ፥ ምድርም እንደ ልብስ ታረጃለች፥ የሚኖሩባትም እንዲሁ ይሞታሉ፤ ማዳኔ ግን ለዘላለም ይሆናል፥ ጽድቄም አይፈርስም።

verses.en: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
verses.am: ጽድቅን የምታውቁ ሕጌም በልባችሁ ያለ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ የሰውን ተግዳሮት አትፍሩ፥ በስድባቸውም አትደንግጡ።

verses.en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
verses.am: እንደ ልብስም ብል ይበላቸዋል፥ እንደ በግ ጠጕርም ትል ይበላቸዋል፤ ጽድቄ ግን ለዘላለም ማዳኔም ለትውልድ ሁሉ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of YAHUAH; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ክንድ ሆይ፥ ተነሥ፥ ተነሥ፥ ኃይልንም ልበስ፤ በቀድሞው ወራትና በጥንቱ ዘመን በነበረው ትውልድ እንደ ሆነው ተነሥ። ረዓብን የቈራረጥህ ዘንዶውንም የወጋህ አንተ አይደለህምን?

verses.en: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
verses.am: ባሕሩንና የታላቁን ጥልቅ ውኃ ያደረቅኸው፥ የዳኑትም ይሻገሩ ዘንድ ጠሊቁን ባሕር መንገድ ያደረግህ አንተ አይደለህምን?

verses.en: Therefore the redeemed of YAHUAH shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የተቤዣቸው ይመለሳሉ ወደ ጽዮንም ይመጣሉ፤ የዘላለምም ደስታ በራሳቸው ላይ ይሆናል፤ ደስታንና ተድላን ያገኛሉ፥ ኀዘንና ልቅሶም ይሸሻል።

verses.en: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;
verses.am: የማጽናናችሁ እኔ ነኝ፥ እኔ ነኝ፤ የሚሞተውን ሰው እንደ ሣርም የሚጠወልገውን የሰው ልጅ ትፈራ ዘንድ አንተ ማን ነህ?

verses.en: And forgettest YAHUAH thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
verses.am: ሰማያትንም የዘረጋው ምድርንም የመሠረተውን ፈጣሪህን እግዚአብሔርን ረስተሃል፤ ያጠፋ ዘንድ ባዘጋጀ ጊዜ ከአስጨናቂው ቍጣ የተነሣ ሁልጊዜ ቀኑን ሁሉ ፈርተሃል፤ የአስጨናቂው ቍጣ የት አለ?

verses.en: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
verses.am: ምርኮኛ ፈጥኖ ይፈታል፤ አይሞትም ወደ ጕድጓድም አይወርድም፥ እንጀራም አይጐድልበትም።

verses.en: But I am YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: YAHUAH of hosts is his name.
verses.am: ሞገዱም እንዲተምም ባሕርን የማናውጥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር እኔ ነኝ፥ ስሜም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.
verses.am: ሰማያትን እዘረጋ ዘንድ ምድርንም እመሠርት ዘንድ፥ ጽዮንንም። አንቺ ሕዝቤ ነሽ እል ዘንድ ቃሌን በአፍህ አድርጌአለሁ፥ በእጄም ጥላ ጋርጄሃለሁ።

verses.en: Awake, awake, stand up, O Yerushalayim, which hast drunk at the hand of YAHUAH the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ የቍጣውን ጽዋ የጠጣሽ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ንቂ፥ ንቂ፥ ቁሚ፤ የሚያንገደግድን ዋንጫ ጠጥተሻል ጨልጠሽውማል።

verses.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.
verses.am: ከወለደቻቸው ልጆች ሁሉ የሚመራት የለም፥ ካሳደገቻቸውም ልጆች ሁሉ እጅዋን የሚይዝ የለም።

verses.en: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁለት ነገሮች ሆነውብሻል፥ ማንስ ያስተዛዝንሻል? መፈታትና ጥፋት ራብና ሰይፍ ናቸው፤ እንዴትስ አድርጌ አጽናናሻለሁ?

verses.en: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of YAHUAH, the rebuke of thy YAHUAH.
verses.am: ልጆችሽ ዝለዋል፤ በወጥመድ እንደተያዘ ሚዳቋ በአደባባይ ሁሉ ራስ ላይ ተኝተዋል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቍጣና በአምላክሽ ተግሣጽ ተሞልተዋል።

verses.en: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
verses.am: ስለዚህም ያለ ወይን ጠጅ የሰከርሽ አንቺ ችግረኛ፥ ይህን ስሚ፤

verses.en: Thus saith thy YAHUAH, and thy YAHUAH that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:
verses.am: ስለ ወገኑ የሚምዋገት አምላክሽ ጌታሽ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ የሚያንገደግድን ጽዋ የቍጣዬንም ዋንጫ ከእጅሽ ወስጃለሁ፤ ደግመሽም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አትጠጪውም።

verses.en: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
verses.am: ነፍስሽንም። እንሻገር ዘንድ ዝቅ በዪ በሚሉአት በአስጨናቂዎችሽ እጅ አኖረዋለሁ፤ ጀርባሽንም ለሚሻገሩት እንደ መሬትና እንደ መንገድ አደረግሽላቸው።

verses.en: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Yerushalayim, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
verses.am: ጽዮን ሆይ፥ ተነሺ፥ ተነሺ፥ ኃይልሽን ልበሺ፤ ቅድስቲቱ ከተማ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ያልተገረዘና ርኩስ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይገባብሽምና ጌጠኛ ልብስሽን ልበሺ።

verses.en: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Yerushalayim: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ትቢያን አራግፊ፤ ተነሺ፥ ተቀመጪ፤ ምርኮኛይቱ የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ የአንገትሽን እስራት ፍቺ።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በከንቱ ተሽጣችሁ ነበር፥ ያለ ገንዘብም ትቤዣላችሁ።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH, My people went down aforetime into Mitsrayim to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
verses.am: ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወገኔ በዚያ እንግዳ ሆኖ ይቀመጥ ዘንድ አስቀድሞ ወደ ግብጽ ወረደ፥ አሦርም ያለ ምክንያት በደለው።

verses.en: Now therefore, what have I here, saith YAHUAH, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith YAHUAH; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
verses.am: ወገኔ በከንቱ ተወስዶአልና አሁን ከዚህ ምን አለኝ? ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ የሚገዙአቸው ይጮኻሉ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ ስሜም ሁልጊዜ ቀኑን ሁሉ ይሰደባል።

verses.en: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወገኔ ስሜን ያውቃል፥ ስለዚህም የምናገር እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ በዚያ ቀን ያውቃሉ፤ እነሆ፥ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy YAHUAH reigneth!
verses.am: የምስራች የሚናገር፥ ሰላምንም የሚያወራ፥ የመልካምንም ወሬ የምስራች የሚናገር፥ መድኃኒትንም የሚያወራ፥ ጽዮንንም። አምላክሽ ነግሦአል የሚል ሰው እግሩ በተራሮች ላይ እጅግ ያማረ ነው።

verses.en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when YAHUAH shall bring again Zion.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጕበኞችሽ ጮኸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ጽዮን በተመለሰ ጊዜ ዓይን በዓይን ይተያያሉና ድምፃቸውን ያነሣሉ፥ በአንድነትም ይዘምራሉ።

verses.en: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Yerushalayim: for YAHUAH hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Yerushalayim.
verses.am: እናንተ የኢየሩሳሌም ፍርስራሾች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አጽናንቶአልና፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ታድጎአልና ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ በአንድነትም ዘምሩ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰውን ክንዱን በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ገልጦአል፥ በምድር ዳርቻ የሚኖሩትም ሁሉ የአምላካችንን መድኃኒት ያያሉ።

verses.en: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እናንተ የእግዚአብሔር ዕቃ የምትሸከሙ ሆይ፥ እልፍ በሉ፥ እልፍ በሉ፥ ከዚያ ውጡ፥ ርኩስን ነገር አትንኩ፥ ከመካከልዋ ውጡ፥ ንጽሐን ሁኑ።

verses.en: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for YAHUAH will go before you; and YAHUAH of Yisra'el will be your rereward.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይቀድማችኋልና፥ የእስራኤልም አምላክ ይከተላችኋልና በችኰላ አትወጡም በመኰብለልም አትሄዱም።

verses.en: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ባሪያዬ በማስተዋል ያደርጋል፤ ይከብራል ከፍ ከፍም ይላል፥ እጅግ ታላቅም ይሆናል።

verses.en: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
verses.am: ፊቱ ከሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ፥ መልኩም ከሰዎች ልጆች ይልቅ ተጐሳቍሎአልና ብዙ ሰዎች ስለ አንተ እንደ ተደነቁ፥ እንዲሁ ብዙ አሕዛብን ያስደንቃል፤

verses.en: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
verses.am: ያልተነገረላቸውንም ያያሉና፥ ያልሰሙትንም ያስተውላሉና ነገሥታት ስለ እርሱ አፋቸውን ይዘጋሉ።

verses.en: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of YAHUAH revealed?
verses.am: የሰማነውን ነገር ማን አምኖአል? የእግዚአብሔርስ ክንድ ለማን ተገልጦአል?

verses.en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.am: በፊቱ እንደ ቡቃያ ከደረቅም መሬት እንደ ሥር አድጎአል። መልክና ውበት የለውም፥ ባየነውም ጊዜ እንወድደው ዘንድ ደም ግባት የለውም።

verses.en: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
verses.am: የተናቀ ከሰውም የተጠላ፥ የሕማም ሰው ደዌንም የሚያውቅ ነው፤ ሰውም ፊቱን እንደሚሰውርበት የተናቀ ነው፥ እኛም አላከበርነውም።

verses.en: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of YAHUAH, and afflicted.
verses.am: በእውነት ደዌያችንን ተቀበለ ሕመማችንንም ተሸክሞአል፤ እኛ ግን እንደ ተመታ በእግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተቀሠፈ እንደ ተቸገረም ቈጠርነው።

verses.en: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ስለ መተላለፋችን ቈሰለ፥ ስለ በደላችንም ደቀቀ፤ የደኅንነታችንም ተግሣጽ በእርሱ ላይ ነበረ፥ በእርሱም ቍስል እኛ ተፈወስን።

verses.en: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and YAHUAH hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.am: እኛ ሁላችን እንደ በጎች ተቅበዝብዘን ጠፋን፤ ከእኛ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ገዛ መንገዱ አዘነበለ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሁላችንን በደል በእርሱ ላይ አኖረ።

verses.en: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
verses.am: ተጨነቀ ተሣቀየም አፉንም አልከፈተም፤ ለመታረድ እንደሚነዳ ጠቦት፥ በሸላቶቹም ፊት ዝም እንደሚል በግ፥ እንዲሁ አፉን አልከፈተም።

verses.en: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
verses.am: በማስጨነቅና በፍርድ ተወሰደ፤ ስለ ሕዝቤ ኃጢአት ተመትቶ ከሕያዋን ምድር እንደ ተወገደ ከትውልዱ ማን አስተዋለ?

verses.en: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.am: ከክፉዎችም ጋር መቃብሩን አደረጉ፥ ከባለጠጎችም ጋር በሞቱ ሆኖም ግፍን አላደረገም ነበር፥ በአፉም ተንኮል አልተገንበትም ነበር።

verses.en: Yet it pleased YAHUAH to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of YAHUAH shall prosper in his hand.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በደዌ ያደቅቀው ዘንድ ፈከደ፤ ነፍሱን ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ካደረገ በኋላ ዘሩን ያያል፥ ዕድሜውም ይረዝማል፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ፈቃድ በእጁ ይከናወናል።

verses.en: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
verses.am: ከነፍሱ ድካም ብርሃን ያያል ደስም ይለዋል፤ ጻድቅ ባሪያዬም በእውቀቱ ብዙ ሰዎችን ያጸድቃል፥ ኃጢአታቸውን ይሰከማል።

verses.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እርሱ ብዙዎችን ይወርሳል፥ ከኃያላንም ጋር ምርኮን ይከፋፈላል፤ ነፍሱን ለሞት አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና፥ ከዓመፀኞችም ጋር ተቈጥሮአልና፤ እርሱ ግን የብዙ ሰዎችን ኃጢአት ተሸከመ፥ ስለ ዓመፀኞችም ማለደ።

verses.en: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: አንቺ ያልወለድሽ መካን ሆይ፥ ዘምሪ፤ አንቺ ያላማጥሽ ሆይ፥ እልል በዪ፥ ጩኺም፤ ባል ካላት ይልቅ ፈት የሆነቺቱ ልጆች በዝተዋልና፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
verses.am: የድንኳንሽን ስፍራ አስፊ፥ መጋረጃዎችሽንም ይዘርጉ፤ አትቈጥቢ፤ አውታሮችሽን አስረዝሚ ካስሞችሽንም አጽኚ።

verses.en: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the nations, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
verses.am: በቀኝና በግራ ትሰፋፊያለሽና፥ ዘርሽም አሕዛብን ይወርሳልና፥ የፈረሱትንም ከተሞች መኖሪያ ያደርጋልና።

verses.en: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
verses.am: አታፍሪምና አትፍሪ፤ አተዋረጂምና አትደንግጪ፤ የሕፃንነትሽንም እፍረት ትረሺዋለሽ፥ የመበለትነትሽንም ስድብ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታስቢም።

verses.en: For thy Maker is thine husband; YAHUAH of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Yisra'el; YAHUAH of the whole earth shall he be called.
verses.am: ፈጣሪሽ ባልሽ ነው፥ ስሙም የሠራዊት ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ ታዲጊሽ ነው፥ እርሱም የምድር ሁሉ አምላክ ይባላል።

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተተወችና እንደ ተበሳጨች በልጅነትዋም እንደ ተጣለች ሚስት ጠርቶሻል፥ ይላል አምላክሽ።

verses.en: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
verses.am: ጥቂት ጊዜ ተውሁሽ፥ በታላቅም ምሕረት እሰበስብሻለሁ።

verses.en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith YAHUAH thy Redeemer.
verses.am: በጥቂት ቍጣ ለቅጽበት ዓይን ፊቴን ከአንቺ ሰወርሁ፥ በዘላለምም ቸርነት እምርሻለሁ፥ ይላል ታዳጊሽ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
verses.am: ይህ ለእኔ እንደ ኖኅ ውኃ ነው፤ የኖኅ ውኃ ደግሞ በምድር ላይ እንዳያልፍ እንደ ማልሁ፥ እንዲሁ አንቺን እንዳልቈጣ እንዳልዘልፍሽም ምያለሁ።

verses.en: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith YAHUAH that hath mercy on thee.
verses.am: ተራሮች ይፈልሳሉ፥ ኮረብቶችም ይወገዳሉ፤ ቸርነቴ ግን ከአንቺ ዘንድ አይፈልስም የሰላሜም ቃል ኪዳን አይወገድም፥ ይላል መሐሪሽ እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
verses.am: አንቺ የተቸገርሽ በዐውል ነፋስም የተናወጥሽ ያልተጽናናሽም፥ እነሆ፥ ድንጋዮችሽን ሸላልሜ እገነባለሁ፥ በሰንፔርም እመሠርትሻለሁ።

verses.en: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
verses.am: የግንብሽንም ጕልላት በቀይ ዕንቍ፥ በሮችሽንም በሚያብረቀርቅ ዕንቍ፥ ዳርቻሽንም ሁሉ በከበሩ ድንጋዮች እሠራለሁ።

verses.en: And all thy children shall be taught of YAHUAH; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
verses.am: ልጆችሽም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር የተማሩ ይሆናሉ፥ የልጆችሽም ሰላም ብዙ ይሆናል።

verses.en: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
verses.am: በጽድቅ ትታነጺያለሽ፤ ከግፍ ራቂ፥ አትፈሪምም፥ ድንጋጤም ወደ አንቺ አትቀርብም።

verses.en: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ይሰበሰባሉ፥ ነገር ግን ከእኔ ዘንድ አይሆንም፤ በአንቺም ላይ የሚሰበሰቡ ሁሉ ከአንቺ የተነሣ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ፍሙን በወናፍ የሚያናፋ ለሥራውም መሣሪያ የሚያወጣ ብረት ሠሪን እኔ ፈጥሬአለሁ፤ የሚያፈርሰውንም እንዲያጠፋ ፈጥሬአለሁ።

verses.en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of YAHUAH, and their righteousness is of me, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: በአንቺ ላይ የተሠራ መሣሪያ ሁሉ አይከናወንም፤ በፍርድም በሚነሣብሽ ምላስ ሁሉ ትፈርጂበታለሽ። የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ርስት ይህ ነው፥ ጽድቃቸውም ከእኔ ዘንድ ነው፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
verses.am: እናንተ የተጠማችሁ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ውኃ ኑ፥ ገንዘብም የሌላችሁ ኑና ግዙ ብሉም፤ ኑ ያለ ገንዘብም ያለ ዋጋም የወይን ጠጅና ወተት ግዙ።

verses.en: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
verses.am: ገንዘብን እንጀራ ላይደለ፥ የድካማችሁንም ዋጋ ለማያጠግብ ነገር ለምን ትመዝናላችሁ? አድምጡኝ፥ በረከትንም ብሉ፥ ሰውነታችሁም በጮማ ደስ ይበለው።

verses.en: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of Dawid.
verses.am: ጆሮአችሁን አዘንብሉ ወደ እኔም ቅረቡ፤ ስሙ ሰውነታችሁም በሕይወት ትኖራለች፤ የታመነችይቱን የዳዊትን ምሕረት፥ የዘላለምን ቃል ኪዳን ከእናንተ ጋር አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለአሕዛብ ምስክር፥ ለወገኖችም አለቃና አዛዥ እንዲሆን ሰጥቼዋለሁ።

verses.en: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, and for the Holy One of Yisra'el; for he hath glorified thee.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የማታውቀውን ሕዝብ ትጠራለህ፥ የእስራኤልም ቅዱስ አክብሮሃልና ስለ አምላክህ ስለ እግዚአብሔር የማያውቁህ ሕዝብ ወደ አንተ ይሮጣሉ።

verses.en: Seek ye YAHUAH while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሚገኝበት ጊዜ ፈልጉት፥ ቀርቦም ሳለ ጥሩት፤

verses.en: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto YAHUAH, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our YAHUAH, for he will abundantly pardon.
verses.am: ክፉ ሰው መንገዱን በደለኛም አሳቡን ይተው፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመለስ እርሱም ይምረዋል፥ ይቅርታውም ብዙ ነውና ወደ አምላካችን ይመለስ።

verses.en: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: አሳቤ እንደ አሳባችሁ መንገዳችሁም እንደ መንገዴ አይደለምና ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.am: ሰማይ ከምድር ከፍ እንደሚል፥ እንዲሁ መንገዴ ከመንገዳችሁ አሳቤም ከአሳባችሁ ከፍ ያለ ነው።

verses.en: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
verses.am: ዝናብና በረዶ ከሰማይ እንደሚወርድ፥ ምድርን እንደሚያረካት፥ ታበቅልና ታፈራም ዘንድ እንደሚያደርጋት፥ ዘርንም ለሚዘራ እንጀራንም ለሚበላ እንደሚሰጥ እንጂ ወደ ሰማይ እንደማይመለስ፥

verses.en: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.am: ከአፌ የሚወጣ ቃሌ እንዲሁ ይሆናል፤ የምሻውን ያደርጋል የላክሁትንም ይፈጽማል እንጂ ወደ እኔ በከንቱ አይመለስም።

verses.en: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
verses.am: እናንተም በደስታ ትወጣላችሁ በሰላምም ትሸኛላችሁ፤ ተራሮችና ኮረብቶች በፊታችሁ እልልታ ያደርጋሉ፥ የሜዳም ዛፎች ሁሉ ያጨበጭባሉ።

verses.en: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to YAHUAH for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
verses.am: በእሾህም ፋንታ ጥድ በኩርንችትም ፋንታ ባርሰነት ይበቅላል፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም መታሰቢያን ለዘላለምም የማይጠፋ፥ ምልክት ይሆናል።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ማዳኔ ሊመጣ ጽድቄም ሊገለጥ ቀርቦአልና ፍርድን ጠብቁ ጽድቅንም አድርጉ።

verses.en: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
verses.am: ይህን የሚያደርግ ሰው ይህንንም የሚይዝ የሰው ልጅ፥ እንዳያረክሰው ሰንበትንም የሚጠብቅ እጁንም ክፋት ከማድረግ የሚጠብቅ ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.en: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to YAHUAH, speak, saying, YAHUAH hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም የተጠጋ መጻተኛ። በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ከሕዝቡ ይለየኛል አይበል፤ ጃንደረባም። እነሆ፥ እኔ ደረቅ ዛፍ ነኝ አይበል።

verses.en: For thus saith YAHUAH unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሰንበቴን ስለሚጠብቁ ደስ የሚያሰኘኝንም ነገር ስለሚመርጡ ቃል ኪዳኔንም ስለሚይዙ ጃንደረቦች እንዲህ ይላልና።

verses.en: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
verses.am: በቤቴና በቅጥሬ ውስጥ ከወንዶችና ከሴቶች ልጆች ይልቅ የሚበልጥ መታሰቢያና ስም እሰጣቸዋለሁ፤ የማይጠፋም የዘላለም ስም እሰጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to YAHUAH, to serve him, and to love the name of YAHUAH, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
verses.am: ያገለግሉት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ይወድዱ ዘንድ ባሪያዎቹም ይሆኑ ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚጠጉትንም መጻተኞች፥ እንዳያረክሱት ሰንበትን የሚጠብቁትን ቃል ኪዳኔንም የሚይዙትን ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
verses.am: ወደ ተቀደሰ ተራራዬ አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ በጸሎቴም ቤት ደስ አሰኛቸዋለሁ፤ ቤቴ ለአሕዛብ ሁሉ የሚሆን የጸሎት ቤት ይባላልና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕታቸውንና ሌላ መሥዋዕታቸውን በመሠዊያዬ ላይ እቀበላለሁ።

verses.en: YAHUAH which gathereth the outcasts of Yisra'el saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል የተበተኑትን የሚሰበስብ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር። ወደ ተሰበሰቡት ዘንድ ሌሎችን እሰበስብለታለሁ ይላል።

verses.en: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.
verses.am: እናንተ የምድረ በዳ አራዊት ሁሉ፥ እናንተም የዱር አራዊት ሁሉ፥ ትበሉ ዘንድ ቅረቡ።

verses.en: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
verses.am: ጕበኞቹ ዕውሮች ናቸው፥ ሁሉ ያለ እውቀት ናቸው፤ ሁሉም ዲዳ የሆኑ ውሾች ናቸው ይጮኹም ዘንድ አይችሉም፤ ሕልምን ያልማሉ፤ ይተኛሉ፤ ማንቀላፋትንም ይወድዳሉ።

verses.en: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
verses.am: መብል ወዳጆች ከቶ የማይጠግቡ ውሾች ናቸው፥ እነርሱም ያስተውሉ ዘንድ የማይችሉ እረኞች ናቸው፤ ሁሉ ወደ መንገዳቸው፥ ከፊተኛው እስከ ኋለኛው ድረስ ሁሉ፥ እያንዳንዳቸው ወደ ጥቅማቸው ዘወር ብለዋል።

verses.en: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
verses.am: ኑ የወይን ጠጅ እንውሰድ፥ በሚያሰክርም መጠጥ እንርካ፤ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነ እንዲሁ ነገ ይሆናል፥ ከዛሬም ይልቅ እጅግ ይበልጣል ይላሉ።

verses.en: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ይሞታል፥ በልቡም ነገሩን የሚያኖር የለም፤ ምሕረተኞችም ይወገዳሉ፥ ጽድቅም ከክፋት ፊት እንደ ተወገደ ማንም አያስተውልም።

verses.en: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
verses.am: ወደ ሰላም ይገባል፤ በቅንነት የሄደ በአልጋው ላይ ያርፋል።

verses.en: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
verses.am: እናንተ የአስማተኛይቱ ልጆች፥ የአመንዝራውና የጋለሞታይቱ ዘር፥ ወደዚህ ቅረቡ።

verses.en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
verses.am: በማን ታላግጣላችሁ? በማንስ ላይ አፋችሁን ታላቅቃላችሁ? ምላሳችሁንስ በማን ላይ ታስረዝማላችሁ?

verses.en: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
verses.am: እናንተ በአድባር ዛፎች መካከል በለመለመም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች በፍትወት የምትቃጠሉ፥ እናንተም በሸለቆች ውስጥ በዓለትም ስንጣቂዎች በታች ሕፃናትን የምታርዱ፥ የዓመፅ ልጆችና የሐሰት ዘር አይደላችሁምን?

verses.en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
verses.am: በሸለቆው ውስጥ ያሉ የለዘቡ ድንጋዮች እድል ፈንታሽ ናቸው፥ እነርሱም ዕጣሽ ናቸው፤ ለእነርሱም የመጠጥ ቍርባን አፍስሰሻል፥ የእህልንም ቍርባን አቅርበሻል። እንግዲህ በዚህ ነገር አልቈጣምን?

verses.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
verses.am: ከፍ ባለውም በረዘመውም ተራራ ላይ መኝታሽን አደረግሽ፥ መሥዋዕትንም ትሠዊ ዘንድ ወደዚያ ወጣሽ።

verses.en: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
verses.am: ከመዝጊያውና ከመቃኑ በኋላ መታሰቢያሽን አደረግሽ፤ እኔን ትተሽ ለሌላ ተገልጠሻል፥ ወጥተሽ መኝታሽን አስፍተሻል፤ ቃል ኪዳንም ተጋባሻቸው፥ ባየሽበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ መኝታቸውን ወደድሽ።

verses.en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.
verses.am: ዘይትም ይዘሽ ወደ ንጉሡ ሄድሽ፥ ሽቱሽንም አበዛሽ፥ መልእክተኞችሽንም ወደ ሩቅ ላክሽ፥ እስከ ሲኦልም ድረስ ተዋረድሽ።

verses.en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
verses.am: በመንገድሽም ብዛት ደከምሽ፥ ነገር ግን። ተስፋ የለም አላልሽም፤ የጕልበትን መታደስ አገኘሽ፥ ስለዚህም አልዛልሽም።

verses.en: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
verses.am: ሐሰትን የተናገርሺው እኔንም ያላሰብሺው በልብሽም ነገሩን ያላኖርሺው ማንን ሰግተሽ ነው? ማንንስ ፈርተሽ ነው? እኔ ብዙ ጊዜ ዝም አልሁ፥ አንቺም አልፈራሽም።

verses.en: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
verses.am: እኔ ጽድቅሽን እናገራለሁ፥ ሥራሽም አይረባሽም።

verses.en: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
verses.am: ወደ አንቺ የሰበሰብሻቸው በጮኽሽ ጊዜ ይታደጉሽ፤ ንፋስ ግን ይወስዳቸዋል ሽውሽውታም ሁሉን ያስወግዳቸዋል። በእኔ የታመነ ግን ምድሪቱን ይገዛል፥ የተቀደሰውንም ተራራዬን ይወርሳል።

verses.en: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጥረጉ፥ መንገድን አዘጋጁ፥ ከሕዝቤም መንገድ ዕንቅፋትን አውጡ ይላል።

verses.en: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verses.am: ለዘላለም የሚኖር ስሙም ቅዱስ የሆነ፥ ከፍ ያለው ልዑል እንዲህ ይላል። የተዋረዱትን ሰዎች መንፈስ ሕያው አደርግ ዘንድ፥ የተቀጠቀጠውንም ልብ ሕያው አደርግ ዘንድ፥ የተቀጠቀጠና የተዋረደ መንፈስ ካለው ጋር በከፍታና በተቀደሰ ስፍራ እቀመጣለሁ።

verses.en: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
verses.am: መንፈስም የፈጠርሁትም ነፍስ ከፊቴ እንዳይዝል ለዘላለም አልጣላም፥ ሁልጊዜም አልቈጣም።

verses.en: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
verses.am: ስለ ኃጢአቱ ጥቂት ጊዜ ተቈጥቼ ቀሠፍሁት፥ ፊቴን ሰውሬ ተቈጣሁ፤ እርሱም በልቡ መንገድ እያፈገፈገ ሄደ።

verses.en: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
verses.am: መንገዱን አይቻለሁ እፈውሰውማለሁ፥ እመራውማለሁ፥ ለእርሱና ስለ እርሱም ለሚያለቅሱ መጽናናትን እመልሳለሁ።

verses.en: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith YAHUAH; and I will heal him.
verses.am: የከንፈሮችን ፍሬ እፈጥራለሁ፤ በሩቅም በቅርብም ላለው ሰላም ሰላም ይሁን፥ እፈውሰውማለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.am: ክፉዎች ግን እንደሚንቀሳቀስ ባሕር ናቸው፤ ጸጥ ይል ዘንድ አይችልምና፥ ውኆቹም ጭቃና ጕድፍ ያወጣሉና።

verses.en: There is no peace, saith my YAHUAH, to the wicked.
verses.am: ለክፉዎች ሰላም የላቸውም ይላል አምላኬ።

verses.en: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Ya'aqob their sins.
verses.am: በኃይልህ ጩኽ፥ አትቈጥብ፥ ድምፅህን እንደ መለከት አንሣ፥ ለሕዝቤ መተላለፋቸውን ለያዕቆብ ቤትም ኃጢአታቸውን ንገር።

verses.en: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their YAHUAH: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to YAHUAH.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ዕለት ዕለት ይሹኛል መንገዴንም ያውቁ ዘንድ ይወድዳሉ፤ ጽድቅን እንዳደረጉ የአምላካቸውንም ፍርድ እንዳልተዉ ሕዝብ እውነተኛውን ፍርድ ይለምኑኛል፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ለመቅረብ ይወድዳሉ።

verses.en: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
verses.am: ስለ ምን ጾምን፥ አንተም አልተመለከትኸንም? ሰውነታችንንስ ስለ ምን አዋረድን፥ አንተም አላወቅህም? ይላሉ። እነሆ፥ በጾማችሁ ቀን ፈቃዳችሁን ታደርጋላችሁ፥ ሠራተኞቻችሁንም ሁሉ ታስጨንቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለጥልና ለክርክር ትጾማላችሁ በግፍ ጡጫም ትማታላችሁ፤ ድምፃችሁንም ወደ ላይ ታሰሙ ዘንድ ዛሬ እንደምትጾሙት አትጾሙም።

verses.en: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to YAHUAH?
verses.am: እኔ የመረጥሁት ጾም ይህ ነውን? ሰውስ ነፍሱን የሚያዋርደው እንደዚህ ባለ ቀን ነውን? በውኑ ራሱን እንደ እንግጫ ዝቅ ያደርግ ዘንድ ማቅንና አመድንም በበታቹ ያነጥፍ ዘንድ ነውን? በውኑ ይህን ጾም፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ የተወደደ ቀን ትለዋለህን?

verses.en: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
verses.am: እኔስ የመረጥሁት ጾም ይህ አይደለምን? የበደልን እስራት ትፈቱ ዘንድ፥ የቀንበርንስ ጠፍር ትለቅቁ ዘንድ፥ የተገፉትንስ አርነት ትሰድዱ ዘንድ፥ ቀንበሩንስ ሁሉ ትሰብሩ ዘንድ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
verses.am: እንጀራህንስ ለተራበ ትቈርስ ዘንድ፥ ስደተኞቹን ድሆች ወደ ቤትህ ታገባ ዘንድ፥ የተራቈተውንስ ብታይ ታለብሰው ዘንድ፥ ከሥጋ ዘምድህ እንዳትሸሽግ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of YAHUAH shall be thy rereward.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ ብርሃንህ እንደ ንጋት ይበራል፥ ፈውስህም ፈጥኖ ይበቅላል፥ ጽድቅህም በፊትህ ይሄዳል፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር በኋላህ ሆኖ ይጠብቅሃል።

verses.en: Then shalt thou call, and YAHUAH shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ ትጠራለህ እግዚአብሔርም ይሰማሃል፤ ትጮኻለህ እርሱም። እነሆኝ ይላል። ከመካከልህ ቀንበርን ብታርቅ፥ ጣትህንም መጥቀስ ብትተው፥

verses.en: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noonday:
verses.am: ባታንጐራጕርም፥ ነፍስህንም ለተራበ ብታፈስስ፥ የተጨነቀውንም ነፍስ ብታጠግብ፥ ብርሃንህ በጨለማ ይወጣል ጨለማህም እንደ ቀትር ይሆናል።

verses.en: And YAHUAH shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሁልጊዜ ይመራሃል፤ ነፍስህንም በመልካም ነገር ያጠግባል አጥንትህንም ያጠናል፤ አንተም እንደሚጠጣ ገነት፥ ውኃውም እንደማያቋርጥ ምንጭ ትሆናለህ።

verses.en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verses.am: ከዱሮ ዘመን የፈረሱት ስፍራዎች ይሠራሉ፥ የብዙ ትውልድም መሠረት ይታነጻል፤ አንተም። ሰባራውን ጠጋኝ፥ የመኖሪያ መንገድን አዳሽ ትባላለህ።

verses.en: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of YAHUAH, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:
verses.am: ፈቃድህን በተቀደሰው ቀኔ ከማድረግ እግርህን ከሰንበት ብትመልስ፥ ሰንበትንም ደስታ፥ እግዚአብሔርም የቀደሰውን ክቡር ብትለው፥ የገዛ መንገድህንም ከማድረግ ፈቃድህንም ከማግኘት ከንቱ ነገርንም ከመናገር ተከልክለህ ብታከብረው፥

verses.en: Then shalt thou delight thyself in YAHUAH; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Ya'aqob thy father: for the mouth of YAHUAH hath spoken it.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይልሃል፥ በምድርም ከፍታዎች ላይ አወጣሃለሁ፥ የአባትህንም የያዕቆብን ርስት አበላሃለሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔር አፍ ተናግሮአልና።

verses.en: Behold, YAHUAH's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ከማዳን አላጠረችም፥ ጆሮውም ከመስማት አልደነቈረችም፤

verses.en: But your iniquities have separated between you and your YAHUAH, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በደላችሁ በእናንተና በአምላካችሁ መካከል ለይታለች፥ እንዳይሰማም ኃጢአታችሁ ፊቱን ከእናንተ ሰውሮታል።

verses.en: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
verses.am: እጃችሁ በደም ጣታችሁም በበደል ረክሳለች፥ ከንፈራችሁም ሐሰትን ተናግሮአል፥ ምላሳችሁም ኃጢአትን አሰምቶአል።

verses.en: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
verses.am: በጽድቅ የሚጠራ በእውነትም የሚፈርድ የለም፤ በምናምንቴ ነገር ታምነዋል ሐሰትንም ተናግረዋል፤ ጕዳትን ፀንሰዋል በደልንም ወልደዋል፤

verses.en: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
verses.am: የእባብን እንቍላል ቀፈቀፉ፥ የሸረሪትንም ድር አደሩ፤ እንቍላላቸውንም የሚበላ ሰው ይሞታል፥ እንቍላሉም ሲሰበር እፉኝት ይወጣል።

verses.en: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
verses.am: ድሮቻቸውም ልብስ አይሆኑላቸውም፥ በሥራቸውም አይሸፈኑም፤ ሥራቸውም የበደል ሥራ ነው፥ የግፍም ሥራ በእጃቸው ነው።

verses.en: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
verses.am: እግሮቻቸው ወደ ክፋት ይሮጣሉ፥ ንጹሑን ደም ለማፍሰስ ይፈጥናሉ፤ አሳባቸው የኃጢአት አሳብ ነው፥ ጕስቍልናና ቅጥቃጤ በመንገዳቸው አለ።

verses.en: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
verses.am: የሰላምን መንገድ አያውቁም፥ በአካሄዳቸውም ፍርድ የለም፤ መንገዳቸውን አጣምመዋል፥ የሚሄድባትም ሁሉ ሰላምን አያውቅም።

verses.en: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ፍርድ ከእኛ ዘንድ ርቆአል፥ ጽድቅም አላገኘንም፤ ብርሃንን በተስፋ እንጠባበቅ ነበር፥ እነሆም፥ ጨለማ ሆነ፤ ጸዳልን በተስፋ እንጠባበቅ ነበር፥ ነገር ግን በጨለማ ሄድን።

verses.en: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
verses.am: እንደ ዕውሮች ወደ ቅጥሩ ተርመሰመስን፥ ዓይን እንደሌላቸው ተርመሰመስን፤ በቀትር ጊዜ በድግዝግዝታ እንዳለ ሰው ተሰናከልን፥ እንደ ሙታን በጨለማ ስፍራ ነን።

verses.en: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.am: ሁላችን እንደ ድቦች እንጮኻለን፥ እንደ ርግብ እንለቃቀሳለን፤ ፍርድን በተስፋ እንጠባበቅ ነበር እርሱም የለም፤ መዳንም ከእኛ ዘንድ ርቆአል።

verses.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
verses.am: ዓመፃችን በአንተ ፊት በዝቶአልና፥ ኃጢአታችን መስክሮብናልና፥ ዓመፃችን ከእኛ ጋር ነውና፥ በደላችንን እናውቃለንና።

verses.en: In transgressing and lying against YAHUAH, and departing away from our YAHUAH, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.am: ዐምፀናል፥ ሐሰትን ተናግረናል፥ አምላካችንንም ከመከተል ተመልሰናል፤ ግፍንና ዓመፅንም ተናግረናል፥ የኃጢአት ቃልንም ፀንሰን ከልብ አውጥተናል።

verses.en: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
verses.am: ፍርድም ወደ ኋላ ተመልሶአል፥ ጽድቅም በሩቅ ቆሞአል፤ እውነትም በአደባባይ ላይ ወድቆአልና፥ ቅንነትም ሊገባ አልቻለምና።

verses.en: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and YAHUAH saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
verses.am: እውነትም ታጥቶአል፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ሰው ለብዝበዛ ሆኖአል።  እግዚአብሔርም አየ፥ ፍርድም ስለሌለ ተከፋ።

verses.en: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
verses.am: ሰውም እንደሌለ አየ፥ ወደ እርሱ የሚማልድ እንደሌለ ተረዳ ተደነቀም፤ ስለዚህ የገዛ ክንዱ መድኃኒት አመጣለት፥ ጽድቁም አገዘው።

verses.en: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
verses.am: ጽድቅንም እንደ ጥሩር ለበሰ፥ በራሱም ላይ የማዳንን ራስ ቍር አደረገ፤ የበቀልንም ልብስ ለበሰ፥ በቅንዓትም መጐናጸፊያ ተጐናጸፈ።

verses.en: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
verses.am: እንደ ሥራቸው መጠን እንዲሁ ቍጣን ለባላጋራዎቹ፥ ፍዳንም ለጠላቶቹ ይከፍላል፤ ለደሴቶችም ፍዳቸውን ይከፍላል።

verses.en: So shall they fear the name of YAHUAH from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of YAHUAH shall lift up a standard against him.
verses.am: እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ነፋስ እንደሚነዳው እንደ ጐርፍ ፈሳሽ ይመጣልና በምዕራብ ያሉት የእግዚአብሔርን ስም፥ በፀሐይ መውጫም ያሉት ክብሩን ይፈራሉ።

verses.en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Ya'aqob, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ለጽዮን ታዳጊ ይመጣል፥ በያዕቆብም ዘንድ ከኃጢአት ለሚርቁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith YAHUAH; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith YAHUAH, from henceforth and for ever.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ጋር ያለው ቃል ኪዳኔ ይህ ነው ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በአንተ ላይ ያለው መንፈሴ በአፍህም ውስጥ ያደረግሁት ቃሌ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ከአፍህ ከዘርህም አፍ ከዘር ዘርህም አፍ አያልፍም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of YAHUAH is risen upon thee.
verses.am: ብርሃንሽ መጥቶአልና፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ወጥቶልሻልና ተነሺ፥ አብሪ።

verses.en: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but YAHUAH shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጨለማ ምድርን ድቅድቅ ጨለማም አሕዛብን ይሸፍናል፤ ነገር ግን በአንቺ ላይ እግዚአብሔር ይወጣል ክብሩም በአንቺ ላይ ይታያል፤

verses.en: And the nations shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
verses.am: አሕዛብም ወደ ብርሃንሽ ነገሥታትም ወደ መውጫሽ ጸዳል ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.
verses.am: ዓይኖችሽን አንሥተሽ በዙሪያሽ ተመልከቺ፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ ተሰብስበው ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፤ ወንዶች ልጆችሽ ከሩቅ ይመጣሉ፥ ሴቶች ልጆችሽንም በጫንቃ ላይ ይሸከሙአቸዋል።

verses.en: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the nations shall come unto thee.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የባሕሩ በረከት ወደ አንቺ ስለሚመለስ፥ የአሕዛብም ብልጥግና ወደ አንቺ ስለሚመጣ፥ አይተሽ ደስ ይልሻል፥ ልብሽም ይደነቃል ይሰፋማል።

verses.en: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of YAHUAH.
verses.am: የግመሎች ብዛት፥ የምድያምና የጌፌር ግመሎች፥ ይሸፍኑሻል፤ ሁሉ ከሳባ ይመጣሉ፥ ወርቅንና ዕጣንን ያመጣሉ የእግዚአብሔርንም ምስጋና ያወራሉ።

verses.en: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
verses.am: የቄዳር መንጎች ሁሉ ወደ አንቺ ይሰበሰባሉ የነባዮትም አውራ በጎች ያገለግሉሻል፤ እኔን ደስ ሊያሰኙ በመሠዊያዬ ላይ ይወጣሉ፥ የክብሬንም ቤት አከብራለሁ።

verses.en: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
verses.am: ርግቦች ወደ ቤታቸው እንደሚበርሩ፥ እነዚህ እንደ ደመና የሚበርሩ እነማን ናቸው?

verses.en: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of YAHUAH thy YAHUAH, and to the Holy One of Yisra'el, because he hath glorified thee.
verses.am: እርሱ አክብሮሻልና ለአምላክሽ ለእግዚአብሔር ስምና ለእስራኤል ቅዱስ ልጆችሽን ከሩቅ ከእነርሱ ጋርም ብራቸውንና ወርቃቸውን ያመጡ ዘንድ ደሴቶች የተርሴስ መርከቦችም አስቀድመው ይጠባበቁኛል።

verses.en: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
verses.am: በቍጣዬ ቀሥፌ በፍቅሬ ምሬሻለሁና መጻተኞች ቅጥርሽን ይሠራሉ፥ ነገሥታቶቻቸውም ያገለግሉሻል።

verses.en: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the nations, and that their kings may be brought.
verses.am: በሮችሽም ሁልጊዜ ይከፈታሉ፤ ሰዎች የአሕዛብን ብልጥግና የተማረኩትንም ነገሥታቶቻቸውን ወደ አንቺ ያመጡ ዘንድ ሌሊትና ቀን አይዘጉም።

verses.en: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
verses.am: ለአንቺም የማይገዛ ሕዝብና መንግሥት ይጠፋል፥ እነዚያ አሕዛብም ፈጽመው ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.am: የመቅደሴንም ስፍራ ያስጌጡ ዘንድ የሊባኖስ ክብር፥ ጥዱና አስታው ባርሰነቱም፥ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፥ የእግሬንም ስፍራ አከብራለሁ።

verses.en: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of YAHUAH, The Zion of the Holy One of Yisra'el.
verses.am: የአስጨናቂዎችሽም ልጆች አንገታቸውን ደፍተው ወደ አንቺ ይመጣሉ፥ የናቁሽም ሁሉ ወደ እግርሽ ጫማ ይሰግዳሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ከተማ፥ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ የሆንሽ ጽዮን ይሉሻል።

verses.en: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
verses.am: ከሰውም ማንም እስከማያልፍብሽ ድረስ የተተውሽና የተጠላሽ ነበርሽ፤ ነገር ግን የዘላለም ትምክሕትና የልጅ ልጅ ደስታ አደርግሻለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the nations, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I YAHUAH am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Ya'aqob.
verses.am: የአሕዛብንም ወተት ትጠጫለሽ የነገሥታትንም ጡት ትጠቢያለሽ፤ እኔም እግዚአብሔር የያዕቆብ ኃይል፥ መድኃኒትሽና ታዳጊሽ እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቂያለሽ።

verses.en: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
verses.am: በናስ ፋንታ ወርቅን፥ በብረትም ፋንታ ብርን፥ በእንጨትም ፋንታ ናስን፥ በድንጋይም ፋንታ ብረትን አመጣለሁ። አለቆችሽንም ሰላም፥ የበላይ ገዢዎችሽንም ጽድቅ አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ በምድርሽ ውስጥ ግፍ፥ በዳርቻሽም ውስጥ ጕስቍልናና ቅጥቃጤ አይሰማም፤ ቅጥርሽን መዳን በሮችሽንም ምስጋና ብለሽ ትጠሪያለሽ

verses.en: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but YAHUAH shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy YAHUAH thy glory.
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም ብርሃንሽ፥ አምላክሽም ክብርሽ ይሆናልና ፀሐይ በቀን ብርሃን አይሆንልሽም፥ የጨረቃም ብርሃን በሌሊት አይበራልሽም።

verses.en: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for YAHUAH shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የዘላለም ብርሃንሽ ይሆናልና፥ የልቅሶሽም ወራት ታልቃለችና ፀሐይሽ ከዚያ በኋላ አትጠልቅም ጨረቃሽም አይቋረጥም።

verses.en: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
verses.am: ሕዝብሽም ሁሉ ጻድቃን ይሆናሉ፤ እኔም እከብር ዘንድ የአታክልቴን ቡቃያ፥ የእጄ ሥራ የምትሆን ምድሪቱንም ለዘላለም ይወርሳሉ።

verses.en: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I YAHUAH will hasten it in his time.
verses.am: ታናሹ ለሺህ የሁሉም ታናሹ ለብርቱ ሕዝብ ይሆናል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር በዘመኑ ይህን አፋጥነዋለሁ።

verses.en: The Spirit of YAHUAH is upon me; because YAHUAH hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
verses.am: የጌታ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእኔ ላይ ነው፥ ለድሆች የምሥራችን እሰብክ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ቀብቶኛልና፤ ልባቸው የተሰበረውን እጠግን ዘንድ፥ ለተማረኩትም ነጻነትን ለታሰሩትም መፈታትን እናገር ዘንድ ልኮኛል።

verses.en: To proclaim the acceptable year of YAHUAH, and the day of vengeance of our YAHUAH; to comfort all that mourn;
verses.am: የተወደደችውን የእግዚአብሔርን ዓመት አምላካችንም የሚበቀልበትን ቀን እናገር ዘንድ፥ የሚያለቅሱትንም ሁሉ አጽናና ዘንድ፤

verses.en: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of YAHUAH, that he might be glorified.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለክብሩ የተከላቸው የጽድቅ ዛፎች እንዲባሉ ለጽዮን አልቃሾች አደርግላቸው ዘንድ፥ በአመድ ፋንታ አክሊልን፥ በልቅሶም ፋንታ የደስታን ዘይት፥ በኀዘንም መንፈስ ፋንታ የምስጋናን መጐናጸፊያ እሰጣቸው ዘንድ ልኮኛል።

verses.en: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
verses.am: ከጥንትም ጀምሮ ባድማ የነበሩትን ይሠራሉ ከቀድሞ የፈረሱትንም ያቆማሉ፤ ባድማ የነበሩትንና ከብዙ ትውልድ በፊት የፈረሱትን ከተሞች እንደ ገና ይሠራሉ።

verses.en: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.am: መጻተኞችም ቆመው በጎቻችሁን ያሰማራሉ፥ ሌሎች ወገኖችም አራሾችና ወይም ጠባቂዎች ይሆኑላችኋል።

verses.en: But ye shall be named the Priests of YAHUAH: men shall call you the Ministers of our YAHUAH: ye shall eat the riches of the nations, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን የእግዚአብሔር ካህናት ትባላላችሁ፥ ሰዎቹም የአምላካችን አገልጋዮች ብለው ይጠሩአችኋል፤ የአሕዛብን ሀብት ትበላላችሁ፥ በክብራቸውም ትመካላችሁ።

verses.en: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.am: በእፍረታችሁ ፋንታ ሁለት እጥፍ ይሆንላችኋል፥ በውርደታችሁም ፋንታ ዕድል ፈንታችሁ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ስለዚህ በምድራቸው ሁሉ እጥፍ ይገዛሉ፥ የዘላለምም ደስታ ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.en: For I YAHUAH love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን የምወድድ ስርቆትንና በደልን የምጠላ ነኝ፤ ፍዳቸውንም በእውነት እሰጣቸዋለሁ፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር የዘላለም ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And their seed shall be known among the nations, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which YAHUAH hath blessed.
verses.am: ዘራቸውም በአሕዛብ መካከል፥ ልጆቻቸውም በወገኖች መካከል የታወቁ ይሆናሉ፤ ያያቸው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር የባረካቸው ዘር እንደ ሆኑ ይገነዘባል።

verses.en: I will greatly rejoice in YAHUAH, my soul shall be joyful in my YAHUAH; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
verses.am: አክሊልን እንደ ለበሰ ሙሽራ፥ በጌጥ ሽልማትዋም እንዳጌጠች ሙሽራ፥ የማዳንን ልብስ አልብሶኛልና፥ የጽድቅንም መጐናጸፊያ ደርቦልኛልና በእግዚአብሔር እጅግ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ነፍሴም በአምላኬ ሐሤት ታደርጋለች።

verses.en: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so YAHUAH will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.am: ምድርም ቡቃያዋን እንደምታወጣ፥ ገነትም ዘሩን እንደሚያበቅል፥ እንዲሁ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ጽድቅንና ምስጋናን በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ያበቅላል።

verses.en: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Yerushalayim's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
verses.am: ስለ ጽዮን ዝም አልልም፥ ስለ ኢየሩሳሌምም ጸጥ አልልም፥ ጽድቅዋ እንደ ጸዳል መዳንዋም እንደሚበራ ፋና እስኪወጣ ድረስ።

verses.en: And the nations shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of YAHUAH shall name.
verses.am: አሕዛብም ጽድቅሽን ነገሥታትም ሁሉ ክብርሽን ያያሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም አፍ በሚጠራበት በአዲሱ ስም ትጠሪያለሽ።

verses.en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of YAHUAH, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy YAHUAH.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር እጅ የክብር አክሊል፥ በአምላክሽም እጅ የመንግሥት ዘውድ ትሆኛለሽ።

verses.en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for YAHUAH delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ። የተተወች አትባዪም፤ ምድርሽም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ። ውድማ አትባልም፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር በአንቺ ደስ ብሎታልና፥ ምድርሽም ባል ታገባለችና አንቺ። ደስታዬ የሚኖርባት ትባያለሽ ምድርሽም። ባል ያገባች ትባላለች።

verses.en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy YAHUAH rejoice over thee.
verses.am: ጕልማሳም ድንግሊቱን እንደሚያገባ፥ እንዲሁ ልጆችሽ ያገቡሻል፤ ሙሽራም በሙሽራይቱ ደስ እንደሚለው፥ እንዲሁ አምላክሽ በአንቺ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Yerushalayim, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of YAHUAH, keep not silence,
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ጕበኞችን በቅጥርሽ ላይ አቁሜአለሁ፤ ቀንና ሌሊት ከቶ ዝም አይሉም፤ እናንተ እግዚአብሔርን የምታሳስቡ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን እስኪያጸና በምድርም ላይ ምስጋና እስኪያደርጋት ድረስ አትረፉ ለእርሱም ዕረፍት አትስጡ።

verses.en: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Yerushalayim a praise in the earth.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ጕበኞችን በቅጥርሽ ላይ አቁሜአለሁ፤ ቀንና ሌሊት ከቶ ዝም አይሉም፤ እናንተ እግዚአብሔርን የምታሳስቡ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን እስኪያጸና በምድርም ላይ ምስጋና እስኪያደርጋት ድረስ አትረፉ ለእርሱም ዕረፍት አትስጡ።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር። ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ በእርግጥ ለጠላቶችሽ መብል ይሆን ዘንድ እህልሽን አልሰጥም፥ መጻተኞችም የደከምሽበትን ወይንሽን አይጠጡም፤

verses.en: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise YAHUAH; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሰበሰቡት ይበሉታል እግዚአብሔርንም ያመሰግናሉ፥ ያከማቹትም በመቅደሴ አደባባይ ላይ ይጠጡታል ብሎ በቀኙና በኃይሉ ክንድ ምሎአል።

verses.en: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
verses.am: እለፉ፥ በበሮች በኩል እለፉ፤ የሕዝቡንም መንገድ ጥረጉ፤ አዘጋጁ፥ ጐዳናውን አዘጋጁ፥ ድንጋዮቹንም አስወግዱ፤ ለአሕዛብም ዓለማ አንሡ።

verses.en: Behold, YAHUAH hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለምድር ዳርቻ አዋጅ እንዲህ ብሎ ነግሮአል። ለጽዮን ልጅ። እነሆ፥ መድኃኒትሽ ይመጣል፤ እነሆ፥ ዋጋው ከእርሱ ጋር ሥራውም በፊቱ አለ በሉአት።

verses.en: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of YAHUAH: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር። የተቤዣቸው፥ የተቀደሰ ሕዝብ ብለው ይጠሩአቸዋል፤ አንቺም። የተፈለገች ያልተተወችም ከተማ ትባያለሽ።

verses.en: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
verses.am: ይህ ከኤዶምያስ፥ ልብሱም የቀላ ከባሶራ የሚመጣ፥ አለባበሱ ያማረ፥ በጕልበቱ ጽናት የሚራመድ ማን ነው? በጽድቅ የምናገር ለማዳንም የምበረታ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
verses.am: ቀሚስህ ስለ ምን ቀላ? ልብስህስ በወይን መጥመቂያ እንደሚረግጥ ሰው ልብስ ስለ ምን መሰለ?

verses.en: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
verses.am: መጥመቂያውን ብቻዬን ረግጫለሁ፥ ከአሕዛብም አንድ ሰው ከእኔ ጋር አልነበረም፤ በቍጣዬ ረገጥኋቸው በመዓቴም ቀጠቀጥኋቸው፤ ደማቸውም በልብሴ ላይ ተረጭቶአል፥ ልብሴንም ሁሉ አስድፌአለሁ።

verses.en: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
verses.am: የምበቀልበት ቀን በልቤ ነውና፥ የምቤዥበትም ዓመት ደርሶአልና።

verses.en: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
verses.am: ተመለከትሁ፥ የሚረዳም አልተገኘም፤ የሚያግዝም አልነበረምና ተደነቅሁ፤ ስለዚህ የገዛ ክንዴ መድኃኒት አመጣልኝ፥ ቍጣዬም እርሱ አገዘኝ።

verses.en: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
verses.am: በቍጣዬም አሕዛብን ረገጥሁ በመዓቴም ቀጠቀጥኋቸው፥ ደማቸውንም ወደ ምድር አፈሰስሁት።

verses.en: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of YAHUAH, and the praises of YAHUAH, according to all that YAHUAH hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Yisra'el, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሰጠን ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነትና የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና፥ እንደ ምሕረቱና እንደ ቸርነቱም ብዛት ለእስራኤል ቤት የሰጠውን ትልቅ በጎነት አሳስባለሁ።

verses.en: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
verses.am: እርሱም። በእውነት ሕዝቤ፥ ሐሰትን የማያደርጉ ልጆች፥ ናቸው አለ፤ መድኃኒትም ሆነላቸው።

verses.en: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
verses.am: በጭንቃቸው ሁሉ እርሱ ተጨነቀ፥ የፊቱም መልአክ አዳናቸው፤ በፍቅሩና በርኅራኄውም ተቤዣቸው፥ በቀደመውም ዘመን ሁሉ አንሥቶ ተሸከማቸው።

verses.en: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ዐመፁ ቅዱስ መንፈሱንም አስመረሩ፤ ስለዚህ ተመልሶ ጠላት ሆናቸው፥ እርሱም ተዋጋቸው።

verses.en: Then he remembered the days of old, Mosheh, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
verses.am: እርሱም እንዲህ ብሎ የቀደመውን ዘመን አሰበ። የበጎቹን እረኛ ከባሕሩ ያወጣው ወዴት ነው ያለ? ቅዱስ መንፈሱንም በመካከላቸው ያኖረ ወዴት ነው ያለ?

verses.en: That led them by the right hand of Mosheh with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
verses.am: የከበረውንም ክንድ በሙሴ ቀኝ ያስሄደ፥ ለራሱም የዘላለምን ስም ያደርግ ዘንድ ውኃውን በፊታቸው የከፈለ፥

verses.en: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
verses.am: በምድረ በዳም እንደሚያልፍ ፈረስ፥ በቀላይ ውስጥ ያለ ዕንቅፋት ያሳለፋቸው ወዴት ነው ያለ?

verses.en: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of YAHUAH caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
verses.am: ወደ ሸለቆ እንደሚወርዱ ከብቶች፥ እንዲሁ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ወደ ዕረፍት አመጣቸው፤ እንዲሁም ለራስህ የከበረ ስም ታደርግ ዘንድ ሕዝብን መራህ።

verses.en: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
verses.am: ከሰማይ ተመልከት፥ ከቅዱስነትህና ከክብርህም ማደሪያ ጐብኝ፤ ቅንዓትህና ኃይልህስ ወዴት ነው? ለእኔም የሆነው የልብህ ናፍቆትና ርኅራኄህ ተከለከለ።

verses.en: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Yisra'el acknowledge us not: thou, O YAHUAH, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.
verses.am: አብርሃም ባያውቀን እስራኤልም ባይገነዘበን አንተ አባታችን ነህ፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ አባታችን ነህ፥ ስምህም ከዘላለም ታዳጊያችን ነው።

verses.en: O YAHUAH, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከመንገድህ ለምን አሳትኸን? እንዳንፈራህም ልባችንን ለምን አጸናህብን? ስለ ባሪያዎችህ ስለ ርስትህ ነገዶች ተመለስ።

verses.en: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
verses.am: የተቀደሰው ሕዝብህ መቅደስህን ጥቂት ጊዜ ወረሱት፤ ጠላቶቻችንም ረግጠውታል።

verses.en: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
verses.am: ከዘላለም እንዳልገዛኸን በስምህም እንዳልተጠራን ሆነናል።

verses.en: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
verses.am: ሰማዮችን ቀድደህ ምነው ብትወርድ! ተራሮችም ምነው ቢናወጡ!

verses.en: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
verses.am: እሳት ጭራሮውን እንደሚያቃጥል፥ እሳትም ውኃውን እንደሚያፈላ፥ ስምህ ለጠላቶችህ ይገለጥ ዘንድ፥ አሕዛብም በፊትህ ይንቀጠቀጡ ዘንድ።

verses.en: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
verses.am: ያልተጠባበቅነውን የክብርህን ሥራ ባደረግህ ጊዜ፥ ወረድህ ተራሮችም በፊትህ ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O YAHUAH, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
verses.am: ሰዎች ከጥንት ጀምሮ ለሚጠብቁህ ከምትሠራላቸው ከአንተ በቀር ሌላ አምላክን አልሰሙም በጆሮአቸውም አልተቀበሉም ዓይንም አላየችም።

verses.en: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
verses.am: ጽድቅን የሚያደርገውን በመንገዶችህም የሚያስቡህን ትገናኛቸዋለህ። እነሆ፥ እነተ ተቈጣህ እኛም ኃጢአት ሠራን፤ ስለዚህም ተሳሳትን።

verses.en: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
verses.am: ሁላችን እንደ ርኩስ ሰው ሆነናል፥ ጽድቃችንም ሁሉ እንደ መርገም ጨርቅ ነው፤ ሁላችንም እንደ ቅጠል ረግፈናል፥ በደላችንም እንደ ነፋስ ወስዶናል።

verses.en: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
verses.am: ስምህንም የሚጠራ፥ አንተንም ሊይዝ የሚያስብ የለም፤ ፊትህንም ከእኛ ሰውረሃል፥ በኃጢአታችንም አጥፍተኸናል።

verses.en: But now, O YAHUAH, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
verses.am: አሁን ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ አንተ አባታችን ነህ፤ እኛ ጭቃ ነን አንተም ሠሪያችን ነህ፥ እኛም ሁላችን የእጅህ ሥራ ነን።

verses.en: Be not wroth very sore, O YAHUAH, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እጅግ አትቈጣ፥ ለዘላለምም ኃጢአትን አታስብ፤ እነሆ፥ እባክህ፥ ተመልከት፥ እኛ ሁላችን ሕዝብህ ነን።

verses.en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Yerushalayim a desolation.
verses.am: የተቀደሱ ከተሞችህ ምድረ በዳ ሆነዋል፤ ጽዮን ምድረ በዳ ኢየሩሳሌምም ውድማ ሆናለች።

verses.en: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን አንተን ያመሰገኑበት የተቀደሰና የተዋበ ቤታችን በእሳት ተቃጥሎአል፥ ያማረውም ስፍራችን ሁሉ ፈርሶአል።

verses.en: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O YAHUAH? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በውኑ በዚህ ነገር ትታገሣለህን? ዝምስ ትላለህን? አጥብቀህስ ታስጨንቀናለህን?

verses.en: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
verses.am: ላልጠየቁኝ ተገለጥሁ፥ ላልፈለጉኝም ተገኘሁ፤ በስሜም ያልተጠራውን ሕዝብ። እነሆኝ፥ እነሆኝ አልሁት።

verses.en: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
verses.am: መልካም ባልሆነው መንገድ፥ አሳባቸውን እየተከተሉ፥ ወደሚሄዱ ወደ ዓመፀኛ ሕዝብ ቀኑን ሁሉ እጆቼን ዘረጋሁ።

verses.en: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝብ ዘወትር የሚያስቈጡኝ ናቸው፤ እነርሱ በአትክልት ውስጥ የሚሠዉ በጡብም ላይ የሚያጥኑ፥

verses.en: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
verses.am: በመቃብርም መካከል የሚቀመጡ፥ በስውርም ስፍራ የሚያድሩ፥ የእሪያ ሥጋም የሚበሉ ናቸው። የረከሰው መረቅ በዕቃቸው ውስጥ አለ።

verses.en: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ለራስህ ቁም፥ እኔ ከአንተ ይልቅ ቅዱስ ነኝና ወደ እኔ አትቅረብ ይላሉ፤ እነዚህ በአፍንጫዬ ዘንድ ጢስ ቀኑንም ሁሉ የምትነድድ እሳት ናቸው።

verses.en: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በፊቴ ተጽፎአል። ኃጢአታችሁና የአባቶቻችሁን ኃጢአት በአንድ ላይ ወደ ብብታቸው ፍዳ አድርጌ አመልሳለሁ እንጂ ዝም አልልም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith YAHUAH, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
verses.am: በተራሮችም ላይ ስላጠኑ፥ በኮረብቶችም ላይ ስለ ሰደቡኝ፥ ስለዚህ አስቀድመው የሠሩትን ሥራቸውን በብብታቸው እሰፍራለሁ።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወይን በዘለላው በተገኘች ጊዜ። በረከት በእርስዋ ላይ አለና አታጥፉት እንደሚባለው፥ ሁሉን እንዳላጠፉ ስለባሪያዎቼ እንዲሁ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Ya'aqob, and out of Yehudah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
verses.am: ከያዕቆብ ዘርን ከይሁዳም ተራሮቼን የሚወርሰውን አወጣለሁ፤ እኔም የመረጥኋቸው ይወርሱአታል፥ ባሪያዎቼም በዚያ ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
verses.am: ሳሮንም የበጎች ማሰማርያ፥ የአኮርም ሸለቆ የላሞች መመሰግያ ለፈልጉኝ ሕዝቤ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But ye are they that forsake YAHUAH, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
verses.am: እናንተን ግን እግዚአብሔርን የተዋችሁትን፥ ቅዱሱንም ተራራዬን የረሳችሁትን፥ ጉድ ለተባለ ጣዖትም ማዕድ ያዘጋጃችሁትን፥ እድል ለተባለ ጣዖትም የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን የቀዳችሁትን፥

verses.en: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.
verses.am: እድላችሁን ለሰይፍ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ሁላችሁም ለመታረድ ትጐነበሳላችሁ፤ በፊቴም ክፉ ነገርን አደረጋችሁ፥ ያልወደድሁትንም መረጣችሁ እንጂ በጠራሁ ጊዜ አልመለሳችሁልኝምና፥ በተናገርሁም ጊዜ አልሰማችሁኝምና።

verses.en: Therefore thus saith YAHUAH, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
verses.am: ስለዚህ ጌታ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ይበላሉ እናንተ ግን ትራባላችሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ይጠጣሉ እናንተ ግን ትጠማላችሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ደስ ይላቸዋል እናንተ ግን ታፍራላችሁ፤

verses.en: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ከልባቸው ደስታ የተነሣ ይዘምራሉ፥ እናንተ ግን ከልባችሁ ኀዘን የተነሣ ትጮኻላችሁ፥ መንፈሳችሁም ስለ ተሰበረ ወዮ ትላላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for YAHUAH shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:
verses.am: ስማችሁንም ለተመረጡት ሕዝቤ እርግማን አድርጋችሁ ትተዋላችሁ፥ ጌታ እግዚአብሔርም ይገድላችኋል፥ ባሪያዎቹንም በሌላ ስም ይጠራቸዋል።

verses.en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in YAHUAH of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by YAHUAH of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
verses.am: እንዲሁም በምድር ላይ የተባረከ በእውነት አምላክ ይባረካል፥ በምድርም ላይ የማለ በእውነት አምላክ ይምላል፤ የቀድሞው ጭንቀት ተረስቶአልና፥ ከዓይኔም ተሰውሮአልና።

verses.en: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አዲስ ሰማይና አዲስ ምድር እፈጥራለሁና፤ የቀደሙትም አይታሰቡም፥ ወደ ልብም አይገቡም።

verses.en: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Yerushalayim a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በፈጠርሁት ደስ ይበላችሁ ለዘላለምም ሐሤት አድርጉ፤ እነሆ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምን ለሐሤት፥ ሕዝብዋንም ለደስታ እፈጥራለሁና።

verses.en: And I will rejoice in Yerushalayim, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
verses.am: እኔም በኢየሩሳሌም ሐሤት አደርጋለሁ በሕዝቤም ደስ ይለኛል፤ ከዚያም ወዲያ የልቅሶ ድምፅና የዋይታ ድምፅ አይሰማባትም።

verses.en: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወዲያ ጥቂት ዘመን ብቻ የሚኖር ሕፃን፥ ወይም ዕድሜውን ያልፈጸመ ሽማግሌ አይገኝም፤ ጕልማሳው የመቶ ዓመት ሆኖት ይሞታልና፥ ኃጢአተኛውም የመቶ ዓመት ሆኖት የተረገመ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.am: ቤቶችንም ይሠራሉ ይቀመጡባቸውማል፤ ወይኑንም ይተክላሉ ፍሬውንም ይበላሉ።

verses.en: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.am: ሌላ እንዲቀመጥበት አይሠሩም፥ ሌላም እንዲበላው አይተከሉም፤ የሕዝቤ ዕድሜ እንደ ዛፍ ዕድሜ ይሆናልና፥ እኔም የመረጥኋቸው በእጃቸው ሥራ ረጅም ዘመን ደስ ይላቸዋልና።

verses.en: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of YAHUAH, and their offspring with them.
verses.am: እነርሱ ከነልጆቻቸው የእግዚአብሔር ቡሩካን ዘር ናቸውና በከንቱ አይደክሙም ለጥፋትም አይወልዱም።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ ሳይጠሩ አመልስላቸዋለሁ፥ ገናም ሲናገሩ እሰማለሁ።

verses.en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ተኵላና ጠቦት በአንድነት ይሰማራሉ፥ አንበሳም እንደ በሬ ገለባ ይበላል፥ የእባብም መብል ትቢያ ይሆናል። በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ ሁሉ አይጐዱም፥ አያጠፉምም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Thus saith YAHUAH, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሰማይ ዙፋኔ ነው፥ ምድርም የእግሬ መረገጫ ናት፤ የምትሠሩልኝ ቤት ምን ዓይነት ነው? የማርፍበትስ ስፍራ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, saith YAHUAH: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.
verses.am: እነዚህን ሁሉ እጄ ሠርታለችና እነዚህ ሁሉ የእኔ ናቸው ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ነገር ግን ወደዚህ ወደ ትሑት፥ መንፈሱም ወደ ተሰበረ፥ በቃሌም ወደሚንቀጠቀጥ ሰው እመለከታለሁ።

verses.en: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine's blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.
verses.am: በሬን የሚያርድልኝ ሰውን እንደሚገድል ነው፤ ጠቦትንም የሚሠዋ የውሻውን አንገት እንደሚሰብር ነው፤ የእህልን ቍርባን የሚያቀርብ የእርያን ደም እንደሚያቀርብ ነው፤ ዕጣንን የሚያጥን ጣዖትን እንደሚባርክ ነው። እነዚህ የገዛ መንገዳቸውን መረጡ፤ ነፍሳቸውም በርኵሰታቸው ደስ ይላታል፤

verses.en: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ የተሳለቀባቸውን እመርጣለሁ፥ የፈሩትንም ነገር አመጣባቸዋለሁ፤ በፊቴ ክፉ ነገርን አደረጉ፥ ያልወደድሁትንም መረጡ እንጂ በጠራሁ ጊዜ አልመለሱልኝምና፥ በተናገርሁም ጊዜ አልሰሙኝምና።

verses.en: Hear the word of YAHUAH, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let YAHUAH be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
verses.am: በቃሉ የምትንቀጠቀጡ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ። የጠሉአችሁ ስለ ስሜም ያባረሩአችሁ ወንድሞቻችሁ። ደስታችሁን እናይ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ይክበር ብለዋል፤ ነገር ግን ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of YAHUAH that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
verses.am: የጩኸት ድምፅ ከከተማ፥ ድምፅም ከመቅደስ፥ በጠላቶቹ ላይ ፍዳን የሚያመጣ የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ተሰምቶአል።

verses.en: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
verses.am: ሳታምጥ ወለደች፤ ምጥም ሳያገኛት ወንድ ልጅን ወለደች።

verses.en: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
